Get a situation report on the sportsdataverse

Source: R/update.R
sportsdataverse_sitrep.Rd

This function gives a quick overview of the versions of R and RStudio as well as all sportsdataverse packages. It's primarily designed to help you get a quick idea of what's going on when you're helping someone else debug a problem.

Usage

sportsdataverse_sitrep()

Value

Called for its side effect of printing the report; returns NULL invisibly.

Examples

# \donttest{
try(sportsdataverse_sitrep())
#> ── R & RStudio ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
